title: Binary affine subspace
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $H$ be a subspace of $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, and let $a\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. The affine subspace based at $a$ with direction $H$ is the translate $a+H$.
